c01.text: Buying a car or van for a summer road trip?

c02.text: Do these three checks before you pay.

c03.text: One. Ask for the VIN and run a PPSR check.

c05.text: and it can flag money that may still be owed,

c06.text: or a stolen or written-off record.

c07.text: Two. Never send money before you've seen the car.

c08.text: Fake ads often have a low price,

c09.text: and a seller who can't meet in person.

c10.text: Three. Get an independent mechanic to inspect it before you buy.

c11.text: Save this for when you're car shopping.
